rubric.role_summary: Senior engineering leader for a software supply-chain security product, responsible for scaling an engineering organization, its operating processes, cross-team delivery, and technical direction while remaining hands-on.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior engineering leader for a software supply-chain security product, responsible for scaling an engineering organization, its operating processes, cross-team delivery, and technical direction while remaining hands-on.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience leading and growing an engineering organization.
- Hands-on software engineering background.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with security or supply-chain security, including shipping security features or working on infrastructure security.
- Experience scaling an engineering organization up to 100 people.
- Experience building and executing operating systems for large organizations, including planning, dependency management, sprint cycles, and surfacing risks.
- Regular hands-on coding and technical depth in architecture, distributed systems, and technical trade-offs.
- Experience managing complex cross-functional programs coordinating 4+ teams on major initiatives.
- A track record of shipping substantial work, including work shipped in the last year.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
